status: Analysis choices fixed after direct coding seal and before viewing new media analysis results; retrospective exploratory research, not prospective preregistration.
feature_aggregation: Previous calendar month. News equal weight per observed outlet; Twitter equal item weight. Content shares use eligible texts, including uncertain economic tone. Tone excludes uncertain; mixed maps to zero.
price_level_reference: December 2018 PCEPI, using numerator and denominator from the same origin vintage
exploratory_extensions: Economy only, economy plus memory, and economy plus memory plus income and cumulative prices; each with/without tone on identical months
All content features together and each fixed feature pair added to economy plus memory, with all results retained
Minimum coverage 2 news/5 tweets and 3 news/5 tweets
Deduplicate identical text after removing URLs, within platform/month; no semantic story deduplication
Strict nonempty US-relevant economic sample versus all economic texts as a geography sensitivity
First-session/new-session coding composition and original 300-review strata
Penalty 0.1 and 10 for baseline/media comparisons without choosing a winner
Forecast changes by calendar year and before/after January 2025
Full macro-period predictions on all 200 monthly origins to assess strength of baseline
Descriptive OLS accounting plus price-level control sensitivity; residual never assigned to media
inference: Fixed existing segment-preserving 3-month circular block bootstrap of paired MAE changes; show all requested comparisons, not best-only. Report small sparse noncontinuous sample and retrospective model coding. No respondent-level exposure, causal or psychological mechanism identification.
